front_hip_key.method: New editable front-panel rest fit to the actual retained skin plus registered source-derived upper-thigh continuity. Nearest surface is restricted to the matching native cut-panel side, with 14 mm stand-off and 40 mm capped control displacement. Graded waist, hem, medial saddle and rear protections remain. Not physical cloth simulation.

chest_rounding.placement: Immediately before retained anatomical clearance, preserving original clearance/fold/subdivision order; front-panel, neck, zipper, shoulder and attachment fades

pelvic_continuity.object: Character | continuous pelvis and upper thigh fitting
pelvic_continuity.weight_method: Pelvis to corresponding native thigh, normalized smooth transition over 0.695-0.865 m in registered rest coordinates. Original fitting support is retained unchanged.

rejected_posed_pelvis_fit: The extra post-subdivision pelvis projection did not consistently improve comparative contact counts. It is not retained.

protected_existing_leg_fits.method: Retain the already fitted lower-leg/medial/fold region; fade new rest changes to zero by summed source influence 0.15. This prevents the new upper-thigh rest fit from fighting established posed leg clearance.

rejected_posed_continuous_hip_fit: Post-subdivision projection to the continuous fitting surface introduced new cotton self-overlaps. It is rejected, not retained.
chest_clearance_order: Place new local chest rounding before retained anatomical clearance. Keep original clearance, authored relief and subdivision order on garment and sewing cage; all existing settings remain.
